description: Link to Perigee showing an object (optionally at a date, paused or accelerated, followed), and an iframe snippet for a lesson page: the live 3D view without bars or panels. The embedding page can then drive the view and take PNG snapshots with postMessage (protocol perigee:v1, documented in `embedApi`). For a star, star_map opens its 3D map with the Sun instead (every named star at its real distance, the Sun–star distance drawn; compare adds a second star), alone in the iframe.

compare.description: With star_map: another star (star:<id>) drawn with its distance to compare.

id.description: Object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "25544" for the ISS.

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

panel.description: Keep the information panel in the embed.

star_map.description: Stars only (star:<id>): open the star's 3D map with the Sun, alone in the embed.

time_bar.description: Keep the time bar in the embed.

name: perigee_view
title: Link or embed a 3D view
